title: Internal notes on a customer chat
summary: A sheet with the notes of one customer chat, from the notes room of the work account (bipe ADR 0284 point 18). Every person on the account reads them. The customer never does.

of.description: Note text, its sender seat when known, and its time.

notes.description: Notes whose noteField room_id is this chat (workNoteFromEvent), oldest first. The author is the seat name when seatId is not null. Reply-by notices never show here.

send.effect: Creates the notes room on first use (roomType, encrypted, only the account's own user, room ID in account data accountDataType), then sends an m.room.message with msgtype m.text, the body and noteField {room_id, seat_id} with this device's seat.

notes: The notes room is silent: it rings no phone (bipe ADR 0284 point 22).
